game_title: Arithmetic Cannon – Ash Rim Trail Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on magma slimes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: In Ash Rim Trail, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on magma slimes. Each round, a new obsidian shards challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the damage value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 340 points of obsidian shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how damage changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 48 seconds.
